L4·N6917unmasked layer
Mostly a suppression neuron: it goes strongly negative on the verb/preposition of speech constructions ("say **to**", "**talk** about", "speaking **about**", "listen **to**"), while its (much weaker) positive firing is on the head noun completing a modified noun phrase naming a concrete item/media object ("on the **cake**", "the Facebook **video**", "expanded text **ads**", "Tw**ine**", "**fan**fiction", "**closed** questions").
